text_coverage.note: Visible source phrases (2+ real words, excluding hidden / display:none twins) absent from the built pages + theme settings, checked on EVERY captured page. Unlike the drop log above, this shares no code path with the builder, so it also catches text lost to a RECOGNIZER claiming a container and ignoring part of it, and text glued to a neighbour so the phrase no longer exists as itself. `items` is content we should have kept (each tagged with the page it came from); `out_of_scope` is text we deliberately did not carry.
